title: Console first-run checklist: host-provided profile so a cloud-managed environment shows first-app and first-record rows
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ① the framework half of objectstack-ai/cloud#4304 item 1 (a task on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」: one checklist on hosted). Seat repo:cloud#1 picked the environment's checklist as the single hosted path, following the maintainer's rulings on objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 (people, apps and records live in the environment). Measured at cloud's pin `b914e724`. Dedupe: `FirstRunChecklist first app host profile` finds no card.
Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4304 (the cloud home checklist retires on hosted once this ships).

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：环境首页「准备好你的系统」清单支持由宿主提供的清单配置：云端托管的环境多出「放进第一个应用」「添加第一条记录」两行，并能隐藏不适用的行。
- 为什么：现在托管客户同时看到云端首页「Getting set up」和环境首页清单两套；按 #4465 的裁决，人员、应用和记录都在环境里，所以环境清单是唯一的入门路径。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

1. Two rows, shown where the host turns them on: "Put your first app in", done when the launcher lists an app (`GET /api/v1/me/apps` non-empty), and "Add your first record", done when a person created a record.
2. The host can hide rows that do not apply, for example Email delivery until the platform channel reads configured (objectstack#32799).
3. Seam: a host-provided checklist profile keyed off the existing cloud-managed flag (plugin-auth `cloud-managed.ts`). No hosted-only branch in console code.
4. Done when tests pin: on a managed environment the two rows draw and tick from real reads; on self-hosted the checklist is unchanged.

Reader: framework console lane (`FirstRunChecklist.tsx`).
